<DOCSTRING>
Manages user data and processes user activities based on age.

This class is responsible for adding users, validating their data, and processing their activities accordingly. It is used by the system to handle user management tasks.

Attributes:
    users (list): List of User objects representing the users in the system. It is initialized when the UserManager is created and is modified by the add_user method.
</DOCSTRING>
